title: VooPoo Uforce-X Vape Tank
description: The Voopoo UForce-X Tank is designed to deliver an exceptional Direct-To-Lung (DTL) vaping experience with its innovative features and robust construction. This sub-ohm tank boasts a 2ml e-liquid capacity, compliant with TPD regulations, and is crafted from durable stainless steel and glass. The UForce-X Tank features a convenient slide top-fill mechanism, ensuring easy and mess-free refills. Its 360° adjustable airflow allows users to customize their draw for optimal flavour and vapour production. The tank is compatible with the entire PnP-X Coil series, providing flexibility for various vaping styles, whether you prefer DTL or Restricted Direct Lung (RDL) vaping. The advanced airflow system and high-quality materials of the UForce-X Tank ensure a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. Available in multiple colours, this tank can seamlessly integrate with any 510-thread mod, offering both functionality and aesthetic appeal. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
